headline: AWS shows local-to-cloud routing agents with Strands Agents
lede: Builders can follow a guide to run routine agent tasks on local small models and route complex ones to cloud models.

possibilities.connection: Rapid-MLX makes local agent loops fast on Apple Silicon, Cline now switches between local and cloud sandboxes with a separate cloud model, and AWS's guide supplies the routing rule for which tasks go where.

possibilities.title: Field operations can keep most agent steps on edge boxes and escalate rarely

with.title: Sage-A1.5, an open 35B MoE agentic model

possibilities.connection: Sage-A1.5 runs agentic work with only 3B active parameters, Ollama decision models return calibrated picks for routing, and AWS's guide shows the local-to-cloud routing pattern.
